method: Independent source review of labelled declaration and registration paths, public contracts, source-safe boundaries and bounded whole-tree reference searches. Author agents read complete declared source coverage; reviewer checks selected truth evidence. No target execution.

reviews.limits: _clear_state unused only under repository-private API boundary; pickle labels describe untrusted-data flow, not absence of policy-level risky-API warnings. Excluded tests earn no credit.
Related libraries, not independent random samples. RegExp.exec property only; no regex complexity safety claim.

Unused methods belong to pattern package, distinct from same-spelled root package receiver. Include tests to measure them. Both router build variants considered by source labels; fixed regex has no scored security contract.
